issue: Include additional kubeconfig fields in encoded data when creating remote secret [closed]
**Describe the feature request**

Background:
`istioctl analyze` doesn't work for multi cluster setups where each cluster needs to be accessed via different proxies. This is because `istioctl create-remote-secret` ignores the `proxy-url` field in the kubeconfig when creating the secret (or more accurately, sets only a [specific set of fields](https://github.com/istio/istio/blame/23fc23c669d0567a029e77fa0fa9ee5dcee094ac/istioctl/pkg/multicluster/remote_secret.go#L702)).
